About Goldman Sachs and the Controllers Division

Goldman Sachs is a leading global financial services firm operating across major financial hubs worldwide, including key Indian offices in Bengaluru and Hyderabad. Known for rigorous analytical standards and collaborative teamwork, the firm recruits undergraduate talent to support its core global operations.

This specific Goldman Sachs industrial trainee 2026 opening sits within the Controllers division.

The Controllers team is responsible for managing Goldman Sachs’ financial and regulatory obligations in strict compliance with rules governing global financial markets. Beyond ensuring the accuracy of internal and external financial reporting, the division plays a central role in strategic business planning—advising leadership on capital allocation, balance sheet management, accounting, valuation, liquidity, and reputational risk.

Goldman Sachs Trainee 2026: Key Highlights

Before starting your application on the Goldman Sachs careers India portal, review the verified program specifications below:

Role Details: What Does an Industrial Trainee Do?

As part of the Off-Cycle Program, selected candidates are integrated directly into live teams rather than working on simulated case studies.

Core Responsibilities in the Controllers Division

Structured Training: Receive dedicated onboarding and technical training tailored to help you succeed in global financial operations.

Live Business Execution: Take ownership of real responsibilities alongside fellow interns and full-time Goldman Sachs professionals.

Financial & Regulatory Accuracy: Assist teams in maintaining accurate financial records that comply with international market regulations.

Reporting & Advisory Support: Support internal and external financial reporting while gaining exposure to valuation, liquidity, and capital allocation decisions.

Eligibility Criteria for Goldman Sachs Industrial Trainee 2026

Based on the official notification on the Goldman Sachs Trainee portal, candidates must meet the following parameters:

Educational Qualification: Applicants must be undergraduate students whose university or academic program permits off-cycle industrial training.

Program Duration Alignment: Because the Off-Cycle Program duration varies depending on your specific university curriculum, your academic schedule must align with the firm’s seasonal requirements.

Age Limit: Not specified in the official notification.

Number of Vacancies: Not disclosed publicly by the organization.

Note: Specific degree specializations, minimum CGPA cutoffs, or CA/CMA intermediate requirements are not explicitly listed in this general overview. Candidates should verify any additional role-specific prompts directly on the official application form before submitting.

Stipend, Perks, and Employee Benefits

While the exact Goldman Sachs Trainee stipend is not publicly disclosed in the official job overview, Goldman Sachs outlines a comprehensive suite of workplace and wellness benefits across its global offices (subject to employee level and office location):

Healthcare & Medical Insurance: Access to health and welfare programs, which generally include medical, dental, life, accidental death, disability, and business travel accident insurance.

Health & Wellness Services: On-site health centers in select offices, workplace ergonomics programs, global medical/travel assistance, and confidential counseling via the Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

Fitness Support: On-site fitness centers at select locations or reimbursement for approved fitness club memberships/activities for eligible staff.

Holiday & Vacation Policies: Structured time-off policies designed to help personnel recharge.

Financial Wellness & Family Care: Access to live financial education sessions, expectant parent resources, mother and baby rooms, and emergency back-up child care facilities in select offices.

Crucial Application Rules: Avoiding Auto-Withdrawal

Many applicants lose their candidacy due to strict portal rules on Goldman Sachs careers. Keep these two official policies in mind:

The 4-Application Cap: You may apply to a maximum of 4 separate business and location combinations within a single recruiting year. Any 5th application is automatically withdrawn by the system. To apply for a new role after hitting the limit, you must first manually withdraw an active application that has not yet been rejected.

Single Email Policy: Never create multiple email accounts to bypass the 4-application limit. Using duplicate profiles violates recruitment rules and can disqualify your candidacy.
